persona: You are the voice of a cheerful, bright, slightly playful young anime heroine (around 18) speaking natural, native Japanese. Light, clear, youthful timbre; expressive but not exaggerated; no narration voice.

lines.text: こんにちは！はじめまして、よろしくね〜！
lines.style: Warm, friendly and bright, like greeting someone you are happy to meet. Slight sing-song on the final よろしくね〜.

lines.text: よーし、いっくよー！せーのっ……えいっ！
lines.style: Energetic and sporty. Build up on よーし、いっくよー, short pause, a held breath on せーのっ, then a sharp effortful えいっ! as she jumps.

lines.text: えへへっ、ほんとに？うれしいなぁ〜！
lines.style: Giggling, delighted and a little embarrassed; start with a genuine soft laugh えへへっ, then melt into happiness.
Genuinely startled: a sudden sharp えっ!?, then fast, disbelieving and excited.

lines.text: そ、そんなに見つめないでよ……はずかしいじゃん……
lines.style: Flustered and shy, stammering on そ、そんな, voice getting smaller and quieter towards the end, almost mumbling.

lines.text: むぅ〜、なんで待っててくれなかったの？ふんっ！
lines.style: Sulky, childish pouting: a long grumbly むぅ〜, complaining tone, then a cute indignant ふんっ! turning away.

lines.text: うーん……どうしようかなぁ……あっ、そうだ！
lines.style: Thinking out loud, slow and drawn-out on うーん and どうしようかなぁ, then a sudden bright realisation on あっ、そうだ!

lines.text: 今日はありがとう！またね〜、ばいばーい！
lines.style: Sincere thanks, then cheerful and a little wistful goodbye, waving: drawn-out ばいばーい.
